k5te01.title: Aries, slow down for once
k5te01.caption:
Aries, not every crush is a race.
Ask, then actually listen. The right one keeps pace with you.

k5te02.title: Taurus, the comfort zone talk
k5te02.caption:
Taurus, put the snack down for one second.
New can feel safe too, and you deserve to be chosen loudly.

k5te03.title: Gemini, say the real thing
k5te03.caption:
Gemini, which tab are you even on right now?
Pick one chat tonight and say the second thought out loud.

k5te04.title: Cancer, who is taking care of you
k5te04.caption:
Cancer, you feed everyone. Who is feeding you?
Let someone take care of you for once. It counts.

k5te05.title: Leo, the spotlight can wait
k5te05.caption:
Leo, the spotlight left and you're still glowing.
You're loved off-stage too. Quiet nights count.

k5te06.title: Virgo, the text was already fine
k5te06.caption:
Virgo, draft fourteen? Draft one was perfect.
You can't edit a feeling. Send it, then breathe.

k5te07.title: Libra, you're allowed to choose
k5te07.caption:
Libra, still deciding where to eat?
Your opinion is welcome here, and no is a full sentence.

k5te08.title: Scorpio, not everything is a clue
k5te08.caption:
Scorpio, "seen 2h ago" is not a case file.
Ask instead of decoding. Trust can be built slowly.

k5te09.title: Sagittarius, staying isn't a cage
k5te09.caption:
Sagittarius, unpack the suitcase. Just for tonight.
Staying isn't a cage, and home can be an adventure.

k5te10.title: Capricorn, love isn't a meeting
k5te10.caption:
Capricorn, it's 2 a.m. and love isn't a calendar invite.
Your worth isn't your output. Let someone hold you.

k5te11.title: Aquarius, feelings aren't a bug
k5te11.caption:
Aquarius, you left mid-hug again, didn't you?
You can be close and free. Say it before you vanish.

k5te12.title: Pisces, cry it out then read
k5te12.caption:
Pisces, wipe your eyes. Five things for you.
Boundaries are love too, and you're allowed to be loved back.

k5te13.title: Aries, you don't have to win this
k5te13.caption:
Aries, it was never a debate.
Cool off, come back, and remember sorry isn't surrender.

k5te14.title: Taurus, letting go isn't losing
k5te14.caption:
Taurus, you can let go of the rope now.
Letting go isn't losing. Your loyalty deserves a return.

k5te15.title: Gemini, one bubble is enough
k5te15.caption:
Gemini, nine texts in a row? One is plenty.
Silence isn't rejection. Ask the deep question instead.

k5te16.title: Cancer, close the old photos
k5te16.caption:
Cancer, 2 a.m. and the old photos are open again.
Missing them is normal. Call a friend and be gentle with you.

k5te17.title: Leo, the selfie can rest
k5te17.caption:
Leo, one selfie, then go live the night.
You're stunning without the angle. Let them hype you.

k5te18.title: Virgo, nobody needs you perfect
k5te18.caption:
Virgo, the checklist reached the floor again.
Nobody needs you perfect. Ask for help out loud.

k5te19.title: Libra, stop saying sorry
k5te19.caption:
Libra, you just apologised to a chair.
Your needs aren't drama. Try saying thanks instead.

k5te20.title: Scorpio, someone wants the real you
k5te20.caption:
Scorpio, hood all the way up again?
Guarded isn't the same as safe. Let one person all the way in.

k5te21.title: Sagittarius, honesty needs a soft landing
k5te21.caption:
Sagittarius, you said it. Out loud. Like that.
Honesty is a gift when it has a soft landing.

k5te22.title: Capricorn, put the bags down
k5te22.caption:
Capricorn, whose bags are you carrying today?
You don't carry everyone. Asking for help is strong.

k5te23.title: Aquarius, everything nobody says out loud
k5te23.caption:
Aquarius, stay to number five. It's the one.
You're not too weird to love, and you're allowed to need people.

k5te24.title: Pisces, you're going to cry at 5
k5te24.caption:
Pisces, bet you cry at number five.
Your feelings are information, and you deserve the love you give.
